title: Just One KISS Website Settings Manifest
purpose: Inventory the JSON settings files needed to build the website from a single source of truth covering canon data, information, settings, options, vocabulary, style guide rules, and brand stories.

central_storage_policy.developer_rule: Website code should read durable facts, labels, options, copy seeds, and governance rules from these JSON settings files rather than hard-coding project canon in templates.
central_storage_policy.promotion_rule: When prototype settings graduate into production behavior, preserve IDs and add migration notes instead of replacing records ad hoc.

settings_file_inventory.purpose: Project identity, event posture, key public facts, disclaimers, owner roles, and durable one-line summaries.
Recommended public and owner-site routes, page purposes, conversion goals, required SSOT dependencies, and launch priorities.
Reusable record fields, validation expectations, workflow statuses, visibility flags, rights/safety states, and timeline classification options.
Voice principles, approved vocabulary, avoided language, copy patterns, audience promises, and public-facing tonal guardrails.
Color roles, type direction, layout language, motif guidance, imagery rules, UI treatment, and accessibility baselines.
Reusable story arcs, hero copy seeds, proof points, audience journeys, and public-safe narrative modules.
Channel inventory, content uses, default CTAs, campaign stages, tracking needs, and asset-format planning hooks.
Asset categories, required metadata, intended website placements, edit statuses, priority labels, and review gates.
Timeline Moment ID families, moment relationship rules, cue-to-website linking policy, and non-timeline GENERAL handling.
Rig families, emergency states, operating rules, safety-first defaults, and technical content disclosure levels for public pages.
Future integration placeholders for CMS adapters, forms, analytics, email capture, ads pixels, media storage, and local AI workflows.
Build conventions, data-loading expectations, naming rules, freshness checks, validation commands, and safe defaults for contributors.

maintenance.next_step: Wire website loaders to this manifest, then expand individual settings files as real content and production integrations are approved.
